name: Unwip 0.43.41
body:
Phone and iPad sync fix:
- A book imported or made again under the same name as one you'd deleted on that device before never synced to Dropbox. Sync quietly skipped it, while still saying "Synced". It now syncs, and books already stuck this way upload on the next sync.

sha256: dd9d059fa25373806bc82de340655f86ace4094afb402baa376972663a9c70db
